metadata.services: Double Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV ($95/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex, I'm calling about a problem with my bill. I seem to be getting charged for something I shouldn't be.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that for you. I understand that billing issues can be frustrating. To get started and access your account securely, could I please have your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, of course. My Customer ID is CUST-1016.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. That's CUST-1016. And for security verification, could you please provide the four-digit security PIN associated with your account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: My PIN is 6-5-3-4.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. I've successfully verified the account. I see I'm speaking with Sandra Wright. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, Ms. Wright. Thank you for verifying that. Now, you mentioned an issue with your bill. Could you tell me a little more about the charge you're seeing?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes. My company account is supposed to be tax-exempt. I submitted all the paperwork when I signed up, but my last few bills have included a state sales tax charge.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see. I'm pulling up your most recent invoice now to take a look. Please bear with me for just a moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I have the statement here. I see your Double Play Bundle for ninety-five dollars, and... yes, I do see a line item for State Sales Tax for seven dollars and thirteen cents. I apologize for that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right. And it's been on there for a few months now. I just noticed it. I have the confirmation email from when I sent in the tax-exempt certificate, if you need it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for that information, Ms. Wright. It sounds like there may have been an oversight on our end when setting up the billing profile. I am very sorry for the inconvenience. I should be able to find the document you submitted in our system.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I hope so. It was a formal certificate of status. It should be on file.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. I'm going to check the document repository linked to your account now. Do you mind if I place you on a brief hold for about thirty to forty-five seconds while I locate that file?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's fine. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, I appreciate your patience. I'll be right back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Ms. Wright.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'm here. Did you find it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I did. I have located the tax-exempt status certificate. It was received and scanned into our system correctly. It appears the error happened in the next step, where the tax-exempt flag was not applied to your billing profile. I sincerely apologize for this error on our part.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so you have it. That's good. So what happens now? Can you fix it and refund me the taxes I've paid?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. I can resolve this for you right now. There are two steps. First, I will update your account to correctly reflect its tax-exempt status so this doesn't happen on future bills. Second, I will calculate the total amount of tax you were incorrectly charged and process a credit to your account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds right. How many months have I been charged for it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me review your billing history. One moment please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, looking back, your services started four months ago. It looks like the tax was applied to all four invoices since the start of your service with Cymbal.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Four months. Okay. So how much does that come to?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The charge has been consistent at seven dollars and thirteen cents per month. So, four months multiplied by $7.13... that comes to a total of twenty-eight dollars and fifty-two cents.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: $28.52. Alright.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. I am now accessing your billing profile to apply the tax-exempt status permanently. Please hold on, the system can be a little slow when making these changes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I've just clicked through the final confirmation. Your account profile is now officially flagged as 'State Sales Tax Exempt'. This will prevent the charge from appearing on all future invoices from Cymbal Telecom.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. Thank you. Now, about the refund for the $28.52?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. The standard procedure is to apply that amount as a credit to your account. This means your next bill will be reduced by twenty-eight dollars and fifty-two cents.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So it would just come off my next payment? My bill is $95, so it would be... what, sixty-six forty-eight?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is exactly right. Your next invoice will show the $95 service charge, and then a separate line item showing a 'Courtesy Credit' for -$28.52, bringing the total amount due to $66.48.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. Is it possible to get that refunded directly back to the credit card I paid with? Instead of a bill credit?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a fair question. A direct refund to a credit card is a more complex process that involves our payment processing department. It typically takes much longer, sometimes up to two billing cycles, to process. The account credit is instantaneous and will be reflected on the very next statement generated.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, I see. Two billing cycles? That's a long time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It can be, yes. That's why we generally recommend the account credit for speed and simplicity. But the choice is yours, of course.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, no, the account credit is fine then. I just wanted to ask. As long as I'm sure it will be there.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand. I am processing the credit now. One moment... okay. I have just posted the credit of $28.52 to your account. It is pending application to the next invoice, which is standard.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, 'pending application'. So it's definitely in the system now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, ma'am. It's locked in. When your next billing cycle closes, our system will automatically apply this pending credit to the new invoice before it's sent out to you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. That's all I needed to hear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm also adding detailed notes to your account right now, documenting our conversation, the error we identified, and the steps taken to correct it, including the credit amount. This is for our records and to ensure clarity for anyone who may look at your account in the future.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I appreciate that. Thank you for being so thorough.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure. It's important that our records are accurate. To give you peace of mind, I can also provide you with a ticket number for today's call and the actions I've taken. Would you like that?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please. I'd like a reference number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. The ticket number is SR-8675309. That's Sierra-Romeo-eight-six-seven-five-three-zero-nine.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, got it. SR-8675309.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. Furthermore, I can have our system send you a follow-up email that summarizes what we've discussed: the tax-exempt status update and the $28.52 credit being applied to your next bill. Would you like me to do that?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, yes, that would be perfect. An email confirmation would be great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I just need to confirm the email address we have on file. Is it sandra.wright@telecom-personal.com?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the correct one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I've just triggered that confirmation email. You should receive it within the next 15 to 30 minutes. It will have the ticket number we just discussed as well.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Alex. I really appreciate you getting this all sorted out for me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome, Ms. Wright. It was my pleasure to assist and correct our mistake. I'm glad we could get your account updated properly.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, to quickly recap: We've updated your billing profile to be tax-exempt, so you won't be charged state sales tax going forward. And we've applied a credit of $28.52 to your account to refund the taxes that were charged in error.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's right. Sounds perfect.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else at all I can help you with today? Any other questions about your Cymbal Telecom service or account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was the only thing. You've answered all my questions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Well, thank you again for your patience and for bringing this to our attention. We appreciate your business.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thank you for your help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Have a wonderful rest of your day, Ms. Wright.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, hello? Are you still there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, Ms. Wright, I'm still here. Did you have another question?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, sorry, one last thing just occurred to me. I just got the email, thank you for that. It mentions the credit. When does my next bill actually come out? I want to make sure I see it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course, I can check that for you. Let me see your billing cycle date. One moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, it looks like your billing cycle closes on the 25th of each month. So your next invoice will be generated on or around July 25th, and it will include that credit.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The 25th. Okay, so in about two weeks. I'll keep an eye out for it then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, and it will be for the service period from July 26th to August 25th. You should see it in your online portal and receive the email notification shortly after the 25th.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's very clear. Thank you for checking that. I just wanted to be sure when to look for it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not a problem at all, I'm happy to clarify. It's always good to know when to expect it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And this change is permanent, right? I won't have to call back about this tax issue again next year?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. The 'State-Tax-Exempt' flag I applied to your billing profile is a permanent marker. It will remain on your account for as long as you have service with us, or until you were to notify us of a change in your tax status.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's a relief. The last thing I want is more administrative headaches.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly understand that. Our goal is to make things as simple as possible for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's really all then. Sorry to keep you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No apology necessary, Ms. Wright. It's important that you have all the information you need and feel confident in the resolution.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well I do. Thank you again, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome. Is there anything else, even a small question, I can help with today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's it. I'm all set.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Thank you once again for calling Cymbal Telecom. We appreciate you as a customer. Have a great afternoon.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
